Multi-tissue application of the bovine spectral library.

SWATH filenames use EarlyFetus (SP871–SP874). Same deposit DDA library uses unambiguous EarFetus for the matching tissue (13 files). EarlyFetus is treated as the same sample type (filename typo/variant of EarFetus), not whole early fetus: only one fetal-related tissue appears in both the 28-tissue DDA and 15-tissue SWATH panels, and source names retain bovine_ear_fetus_*. Developmental stage set to embryo stage (EFO:0007725).
